I’ll read the Phase 5 border requirements and the importer’s current border handling, then implement per-side border support.

The importer currently uses the top border’s width and color for every edge, so bottom-only and left-only borders can disappear. I’m adding per-side paint data, editable border layers, and a fixture covering colors, opacity, clipping, and transforms.
